title: Resident wounded during attempted home robbery in Minga Guazú
summary: Reviewed English summary: Noticiero Paraguay reports that a resident was shot during an attempted home robbery in Minga Guazú, Alto Paraná, on September 28. Four intruders reportedly fled, and police collected evidence. The injured resident received hospital care. The motive and suspects’ identities remained under investigation.
